description: Search and query government open-data portals (Socrata SODA API).

tool_signatures.name: socrata_dataframe_describe
tool_signatures.description: List registered tables in a DataCanvas session — schema, row count, column names, and registration time. Shows what datasets are available for SQL queries via socrata_dataframe_query. Only meaningful when CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb is set. Use after socrata_query_dataset spills a large result set to canvas.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by socrata_query_dataset when a large result spills to canvas. Required in practice when canvas is enabled — canvases cannot be enumerated, so omitting it fails with canvas_id_required instead of listing tables.

notice.description: Status message when canvas is not enabled or no tables are registered. Absent when tables are present.

type.description: DuckDB inferred type (e.g. VARCHAR, DOUBLE, BIGINT).

columns.description: Column names and DuckDB types. Numeric SODA columns become queryable with numeric comparisons after spillover.

table_id.description: Table name registered on the canvas.

row_count.description: Number of rows in this table.

tables.description: Tables available for SQL queries. Empty when none registered.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID resolved, when canvas is enabled.

tool_signatures.name: socrata_dataframe_query
tool_signatures.description: Run SELECT-only SQL against a DataCanvas table populated by socrata_query_dataset. DuckDB infers types from spilled data, so numeric columns that SODA returned as strings become queryable with numeric comparisons (year > 2020, amount < 500). Only works when CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb is set. Use socrata_dataframe_describe to see registered tables and their schemas.

sql.description: SELECT-only SQL to run against registered canvas tables. DDL, DML, and file-reading functions are rejected. Use table names from socrata_dataframe_describe.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned from socrata_query_dataset or socrata_dataframe_describe.

cap.description: The row limit that was applied when capped.

rows.description: Query result rows. DuckDB may return native JS types (number, boolean, null) for numeric/boolean columns.

shown.description: Rows returned in this response when capped.

notice.description: Guidance when the SQL returned zero rows. Absent when rows are present.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit — more rows match the query.

tool_signatures.name: socrata_find_datasets
tool_signatures.description: Search for datasets across all Socrata-powered government open-data portals, or scope to one portal with the domain parameter. Returns dataset IDs, names, abbreviated column lists, domains, and update timestamps. Use socrata_get_dataset to fetch the full typed column schema before writing queries — columnNames here are preview-only and lack type information.

only.description: Filter by asset type. Omit to include all types. Usually "datasets" is what you want.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–100). Default 10.

order.description: Sort order. Defaults to relevance. Use updated_at to surface recently-refreshed datasets.

query.description: Full-text search across dataset names and descriptions. Omit to browse without filtering.

domain.description: Scope search to a single portal (e.g. data.seattle.gov, data.cityofnewyork.us). Omit to search all portals.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters and suggests how to broaden. Absent on non-empty result pages.

domain.description: Portal domain hosting this dataset (e.g. data.seattle.gov).

dataset_id.description: Four-by-four dataset ID (e.g. kzjm-xkqj). Pass to socrata_get_dataset or socrata_query_dataset.

column_names.description: Preview column name list (no type info). Call socrata_get_dataset for typed schema.

data_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last data update when available.

results.description: Matching datasets. Empty when no results.

totalCount.description: Total matches before pagination. 0 when empty.

tool_signatures.name: socrata_get_dataset
tool_signatures.description: Fetch full metadata and column schema for a Socrata dataset by ID. Returns field names, data types, descriptions, row count, and licensing. Always call this before writing a socrata_query_dataset — the column types determine correct WHERE clause syntax: Number columns accept bare literals (year=2023) while Text columns require single-quoted strings (year='2023').

domain.description: Portal domain (e.g. data.seattle.gov). Defaults to SOCRATA_DEFAULT_DOMAIN env var or data.seattle.gov.

dataset_id.description: Four-by-four dataset ID matching pattern like kzjm-xkqj. Obtain from socrata_find_datasets.

data_type.description: Socrata data type (e.g. Number, Text, Calendar date). Determines WHERE clause quoting: Number → bare literal, Text → single-quoted string.

field_name.description: Column field name as used in SoQL queries.

non_null_count.description: Non-null row count for this column when available.

items.description: A single column in the dataset schema.

columns.description: Column schema. Computed region columns (:@computed_region_*) are excluded to reduce noise.

row_count.description: Approximate row count when available. See row_count_source for provenance.

data_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last data update when available.

row_count_source.description: How row_count was obtained: 'top_level_cached_contents' — reported directly by the portal's views metadata; 'column_cached_contents' — derived as the maximum per-column cached count when the top-level value is absent. Absent when row_count is absent.

tool_signatures.name: socrata_list_portals
tool_signatures.description: List known Socrata-powered government open-data portals with their domain, organization name, and approximate dataset count. The catalog is a curated list of 40 well-known portals; dataset counts are fetched from the Discovery API and cached for ~24 hours. Filtering is client-side substring match on the query parameter. Use this first when you do not know which portal to target, then pass the domain to socrata_find_datasets.

query.description: Keyword to filter portal names or organization names (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to list all portals.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no portals matched the filter. Absent on non-empty pages.

domain.description: Portal domain (e.g. data.seattle.gov). Pass to socrata_find_datasets.

organization.description: Organization name when available (e.g. City of Seattle).

dataset_count.description: Approximate count of dataset-type assets on this portal from the Discovery API catalog (point-in-time, refreshed ~daily). 0 means the portal exposes no dataset assets to the catalog; null means the live count is temporarily unavailable.

portals.description: Matching portals. Empty when no results.

totalCount.description: Total portals before pagination. 0 when empty.

tool_signatures.name: socrata_query_dataset
tool_signatures.description: Execute a SoQL query against any dataset on any Socrata portal. Use the search parameter for quick full-text lookup, or combine select/where/group/having/order for full analytical control. Returns rows plus the assembled SoQL string so you can learn the pattern. All SODA 2.1 row values are strings even for numeric columns — check dataType from socrata_get_dataset to determine correct WHERE quoting: Number columns use bare literals (year=2023), Text columns use single-quoted strings (year='2023'). To enumerate distinct values, use select="col, count(*) as n" with group="col" and order="n DESC". When CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb and rows fill the limit, results spill to a DataCanvas table for SQL-based analysis.

group.description: SoQL GROUP BY clause. Requires an aggregate function in select.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1–5000). Default 100. Use with offset for pagination.

order.description: SoQL ORDER BY clause, e.g. "total_deaths DESC" or "date ASC".

where.description: SoQL WHERE clause. Check column dataType from socrata_get_dataset first — Number columns: year=2023, Text columns: year='2023'. Operators: =, !=, >, <, LIKE, IN(...), BETWEEN, IS NULL, starts_with(), contains(), AND, OR, NOT.

domain.description: Portal domain (e.g. data.seattle.gov). Defaults to SOCRATA_DEFAULT_DOMAIN or data.seattle.gov.

having.description: SoQL HAVING clause. Filters on aggregated results, e.g. count > 100.

search.description: Full-text search across all text columns ($q). For field-specific filtering, use where instead.

select.description: SoQL SELECT clause — column names, aliases, aggregates: "state, sum(deaths) as total_deaths". Omit for all columns.

canvas_id.description: Optional 10-char DataCanvas token from a prior call. Omit on first call when CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb to mint a fresh canvas. Large result sets spill here automatically.

dataset_id.description: Four-by-four dataset ID (e.g. kzjm-xkqj). Obtain from socrata_find_datasets.

cap.description: The row limit that was applied when capped.

rows.description: Result rows. Scalar values are strings (SODA 2.1); geo/location columns return nested objects. Use column schema from socrata_get_dataset for type context.

shown.description: Rows returned in this response when capped.

notice.description: Guidance when the query returned zero rows — suggests narrowing or reviewing the SoQL. Absent on non-empty result sets.

canvas_id.description: DataCanvas token when results spilled (requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb). Pass to socrata_dataframe_query for SQL over the full result set.

truncated.description: True when rows filled the limit — more rows may match (see total_count when present). Spills to canvas when enabled.

total_count.description: Total matching source rows when a plain row query is truncated (row_count < total_count). Absent when the full result fits and for grouped/aggregate queries (group set), where a source-row count would not describe the returned groups.

assembled_query.description: SoQL clauses assembled for this request — useful for learning the syntax.
